The '''Umbra Club''' was a seedy, underworld [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] and nightclub that was situated within [[Sector 1459]], in the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|undercity]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Outside the club were elaborate holovid screens that gave the false impression that it was an upscale establishment. The club, which was run by [[Omacala]], was a popular haunt of [[Death stick/Legends|death stick]] [[Drug dealer|dealers]] and addicts, and during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], various thugs loyal to the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Death/Legends|death]] stick dealer [[Speng]] operated opening within the club. The [[Kadas'sa'Nikto/Legends|Kadas'sa'Nikto]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Kaa'to Leeachos]] was a patron of the club and after Leeachos earned the ire of the [[Pyke Syndicate/Legends|Pyke Syndicate]] and went into hiding, a group of Pyke-affiliated agents ventured to the Umbra Club in search of information on the [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto's]] activities.<ref name="UABS" />
